summary: ALX Oncology Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a loan and security agreement with HSBC Ventures USA Inc. The agreement provides a secured multi-tranche term loan facility up to $50 million, with $10 million borrowed at closing to refinance existing debt. No equity, acquisition, or special-situations transaction is involved. The filing is a routine disclosure of a credit facility for general corporate purposes, maturing June 1, 2030, with floating interest at prime or 6% minimum. There are no deal terms implying a special situation. This is a straightforward debt financing arrangement.
